card.name: Start of next entry in dose tables
card.fires_on: The first piece of a new entry right after a run of numbers in a dosing or weight table, such as a leading 0 or 2 or a space before the next row. It also fires at a new statement after such a table.

modes.label: Leading digit in table cell
modes.description: A leading 0 or digit that starts a new number in a weight-band dosing table.
modes.example: .4 mL 62 kg to 114 kg 12 mg 0.6 mL More than 114 kg <<0>>.15 mg/kg See below*

modes.label: Space between table rows
modes.description: A space between number groups where one table row ends and the next begins.

modes.label: New statement after numbers
modes.description: The first word of a new item following a number run, such as a drug name or a SQL command.
modes.example: /200 mcg three times a day two times a day 150 100 600 400<< D>>iclofenac sodium and misop

card.plain: It marks the spot where a new number or row starts in a flattened dosing table.
